faqs.q: Sec. 18-503. - I.P.M.C. Section 304.10, Stairways, decks, porches and balconies.
faqs.a:
Section 304.10. Stairways, decks, porches and balconies,
is hereby amended to read as follows:
"
304.10. Stairways, decks, porches and balconies.
Every exterior stairway, deck, porch and balcony, and all appurtenances attached
                  thereto, shall be maintained structurally sound, with proper anchorage and capable
                  of supporting the imposed loads."
(Ord. No.
4738
, § 12, 9-14-2020)
